def lines_of(g):
    # returns dict: key=(dy,dx,color), value=list of cells on that diagonal line
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    ret={}
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            v=g[r][c]
            # two slopes through this cell
            for dy,dx in ((1,1),(1,-1)):
                cells=[]; y,x=r,c
                while 0<=y<H and 0<=x<W:
                    cells.append((y,x))
                    y+=dy; x+=dx
                ret.setdefault((dy,dx,v),[]); ret[(dy,dx,v)].extend(cells)
    return ret

def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    li=lines_of(g)
    lines=[(k,v) for k,v in li.items() if len(v)>1 and all(g[y][x]!=bg for y,x in v)]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for (dy,dx,col),cells in lines:
        ys=[p[0] for p in cells]; xs=[p[1] for p in cells]
        cy=(min(ys)+max(ys))/2; cx=(min(xs)+max(xs))/2
        # object bbox center of the line's span

            # direction away: sign such that distance increases
            for dd,ddx in ((dy,dx),(-dy,-dx)):
